g.text: Losing a region in a 2-2-1 layout
3 of 5 replicas remain: a majority. Zeebe elects new leaders and keeps processing.
1. Promote the paris standby, because the writer was in london.
2. Route client traffic away from london (DNS failover or a global load balancer).
3. Recommended: remove the lost zone with failover.sh --drain-brokers.
